headlines.text: Looking back to 2022, when Jeff Hardy vs. Darby Allin settled things in a No DQ match, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 7.69 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle in a hard-fought men's division clash. A dream match between two daredevils, with Darby personally requesting the rules be thrown out entirely ? a wild, chair-and-ladder-strewn brawl that saw Allin dive off a ladder through a row of chairs, ultimately stealing the show even in defeat.
Flash back to 2024, when Tommy Billington touched down in AEW for the first time against Dax Harwood, appearing on Collision, rated 6.88.
That Saturday in 2024, Adam Copeland vs. Kyle O'Reilly closed out Collision, rated 7.84 ? a well-worked match.
